verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own founder states they integrate via Gmail's proprietary APIs 'not IMAP,' and there is no mention anywhere in docs of JMAP, SMTP-level access, or standards-based export tooling — the product only works atop Google's servers (also confirmed by a security-focused user noting 'it only works with Google servers'). No evidence of any open-protocol mail access or portable export path exists in the pack.
